host.description: Bare MySQL hostname or IP address. URL-shaped values and embedded credentials are rejected.

port.description: TCP port, 1-65535. Defaults to 3306 when omitted.

database.description: MySQL database to discover and read.

sslmode.description: Transport security. disabled never negotiates TLS; preferred (the default) encrypts when the server offers TLS and is the only mode that falls back to plaintext; required encrypts and fails when the server offers no TLS; verify-ca also verifies the server chain; verify-identity also verifies the server name. libpq and underscore spellings are accepted for compatibility; use canonical values for a portable policy across SQL connectors.

sslrootcert.description: Absolute path to a PEM CA bundle used by verify-ca and verify-identity. Defaults to the host trust store when omitted.

sslservername.description: Server name to verify under verify-identity when it differs from host, such as an IP-addressed endpoint fronting a named certificate.

cursor_field.description: Optional safe, non-null, single-column primary or unique key for cursor-incremental reads. A present cursor state, including an empty or whitespace value, is a strict resume boundary.

page_size.description: Maximum records per read page. Defaults to 1000.

read_limit.description: Total maximum rows for a Read. Defaults to 10000; set to 0, all, or unlimited to disable this bound.
